verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the realtime WebSocket endpoint path wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2/, which shows Speechmatics uses URL-based API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a changelog, so only the versioning half of the story is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning for the batch and TTS APIs, a published changelog or version lifecycle docs, and any independent corroboration.
